description: Sets 1 to 25 workouts or programs to public or private in one go. Use when the user wants to publish content to members, hide it, or make it team-only. Not for deleting content (use delete_items). Returns which IDs changed and why any failed. Changes what members see right away.

ids.description: IDs of the workout or programs, 1 to 25. Get them from list_team_workouts or list_team_programs.

type.description: What to act on: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

visibility.description: public = members can see it in the app; private = team only (private needs a plan that includes it).

name: set_content_visibility
title: Set workout or program visibility
